source.stem: Decide whether the following statements are correct. Mark “√” for correct answers and “×” for wrong answers. (1) Objects that can move must be living things.

hinge.title: Use the faster heating and cooling of land than water to decide the direction of daytime sea breeze and nighttime land breeze.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Day: land → sea. Night: sea → land.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: Large freshwater lake, daytime: no breeze toward the warmer shore.

intelligence.enrichment: Soil heats up faster and cools down faster than water; air above the warmer surface rises, and cooler air moves in from the other surface. Time of day changes which surface is warmer, which controls where air rises and therefore which direction cooler air moves near the coast. The learner correctly applies this rule: Soil heats up faster and cools down faster than water; air above the warmer surface rises, and cooler air moves in from the other surface. Wind near the coast always blows from the same direction because the sea is always cooler than land.
